@Sofia Marchetti, the most recent statement in #coastal-team says Pellucid Harbor Logistics stays with Kwame. Bettina Kroll posted on Oct 14 that she is covering Pellow while Sofia is at Hagerstown next week, and that Pellucid "stays with Kwame, nothing changes there." That is the latest I can see. I don't have access to an account ownership record, so please confirm with Kwame or Bettina before routing the ticket.

I also noticed the PHL acronym is shared by two accounts, Pellow Home Living and Pellucid Harbor Logistics, which may explain the misrouting. Ticket routing is a Support matter, so you may want to ask them to use the full account name.
